description: 6 exemplars (one German) + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-26 under road-to-database-keys-that-hold, which corrected this skill's migration template and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover what its description names — creating a migration with make:migration, adding a column on an explicit connection, a foreign key with a chosen referential action, a multi-tenant table — plus the down() contract and a German request. Near-misses share migration vocabulary and are somebody else's job: the rollout strategy of a risky schema change (migration-architect), the reviewer's pass over a schema diff (schema-review), and the raw DDL statement a migration wraps (sql-writing). Counterexamples guard the word migration: a data-center move and a mail-provider migration.
